articles.title: From Phuket to Global Fame: Nene Royal Becomes First Thai Winner of America's Got Talent
articles.summary: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old guitarist from Thailand, won America's Got Talent and a million-dollar prize. Her viral audition has 21 million views — and she's already planning a rock album.

articles.title: Alcaraz Loses at 3:34 A.M., Walks Off Smiling: 'I Suffered, But I Enjoyed'
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set US Open match at 3:34 a.m. — then smiled in the tunnel. After five months out with a wrist injury, he said he missed the feeling of competing.

articles.title: SNL Season 52 Kicks Off Tonight with NBA Champ Jalen Brunson and KATSEYE
articles.summary: Saturday Night Live returns tonight for its Season 52 premiere. New York Knicks point guard Jalen Brunson hosts, fresh off an NBA championship, with KATSEYE as musical guest.
